author: Dale Wightman
content:
Extremely helpful and polite staff plus great kit!

I'd highly recommend this company for their soft play toys.  We rented the following:  BALL POND, ROLLER COASTER, BIKES and BUILDING BLOCKS.

The party was a huge success and every communication with the team was perfect from ordering online, email communication and meeting the guys at delivery and pick up.

Thank you Dancing Cubs for making the party a success and making my life that little bit easier with your professionalism and assistance!
